notes:

A third line for the nested test beside the clean line and the '+ engineered features*' line: features from a mechanical generator (OpenFE, Zhang et al. NeurIPS 2023) with no human ideas, so the 2016-2024 grade cannot carry ideas leakage. INPUTS (raw values on every panel row, the panel's point-in-time conventions): (1) the champion's 64 model features before per-week ranking; (2) every numeric field of the store's fundamentals table (27 fields), trailing-12-month dimension, as the latest filed level (filed + 1 day, 400-day tolerance) and its year-over-year change (row 4 quarters earlier, report-period gap 330-400 days, prior value > 0: x/prev - 1); (3) every 8-K item code with >= 100 filings in the store (23 of 30 codes): filings carrying it in the last 182 days, available the day after SEC acceptance; (4) the nominal close on the rank date. About 142 inputs; no lags, no other windows. CANDIDATES: OpenFE order-1 numeric enumeration: every unordered pair x {+, -, *, /, min, max} plus |x| per input (~60k); monotone unary transforms omitted (identical after per-week ranking). SCORING WINDOW: rank weeks 2006-01-01 -> 2015-12-31 whose label_4w ends inside the window (35-day cutoff), members with a label. Base model: LightGBM on the 64 raw base features, out-of-fold over 5 folds of interleaved 26-week blocks, 35-day purge; its predictions are the init scores. Stage 1 (OpenFE 'predictive'): a 100-tree LightGBM on the residual per candidate, early stop 3, val = fold 0's blocks (purged), every candidate on all its rows - no subsample halving (n_data_blocks=1). Stage 2 (admission): one LightGBM (OpenFE's stage-2 params) on 64 base + the store inputs + the 2000 best stage-1 candidates, init_score as above; the bundle = the 40 columns (store input or formula) with the highest gain importance (fewer if fewer have positive gain), rank-normalized per week and neutral-filled as g_ columns (formulas.json). COST BOUND: a timing run on 2010's weeks with 3000 random candidates projects stage 1; if the projection for the full window exceeds 6 hours, stop and report without fitting. GRADE: one walk at the champion's settings (4w / 5y / K=4 / top-6 / 70-30 trend ballast / no stop / cap 2) with ctx.extra = the bundle, rank weeks 2006-01 -> 2024-07-18 (the bundle walk's span; holdout untouched), selection.simulate on the live rules; the number is 2016-01 -> 2024-07-19 exclusive beside clean ($590) and + ideas* ($772) from champion_bundle_grades.json and SPY; 2006-2015 reported as in-sample. Clarification (2026-09-05, before any number): (1) candidates are computed on raw values and scored after per-week rank normalization (neutral-filled), the same transform the model sees; the base features enter stage 2 as the panel's ranked columns. (3) 8-K item codes are the post-2004 numbering only (n.nn; 23 codes with >= 100 filings).
